DARV.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancient:
Looking a little glum there, pal!
Wanna take a peek for something nice?
DARV.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancient: Thought I wouldn't see you back here ever again!!
DARV.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-0.ancient: Hey friend! Found a couple of [sine]weird looking bones[/sine] you might just be interested in!
NEOW.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.char: Well, aren't you a precious one.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancien:
Such [sine]rustic[/sine] garb for such a [sine]gorgeous[/sine] fox!
Come, allow me to retire your scraps.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancie: Again? In [jitter]rags[/jitter]? What have you done to my precious garments?
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-0.ancien: If only you'd do with The Architect what you [i]continue[/i] to do with your clothes...
OROBAS.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancient:
Woods lady! From a tree!? With a dog??
Rrats!! Owls!! Birds!! Friends!!
OROBAS.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Witch presents a trove of crow-acquired treasures.[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancient:
Look!! Bird shinies rainbow Now!!
Ate half of them !! Tasty!!
OROBAS.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-1.char: Indeed you may, but they bite.
OROBAS.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-2.ancient: Friends!!? We are forever friends!! Bring every dog!! To me!!
PAEL.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancient:
[thinky_dots]You rest not a wink.
Brew fruit of my flesh and sleep...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Do the trees hold the dreams of squirrels?
Or do they rustle peacefully...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-1.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Why, it is me! In abundance.
A feast to be shared...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancient: A BEAR?? WOLF? AN ARMY OF WARRIORS!!
TANX.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-1.char: The might of the forest is unmatched!
TANX.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-2.ancient: RAHHH! I WILL FIGHT THEM ALL!!
TANX.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancient: BEAR QUEEN!! ARM YOUR LEGIONS WITH SWORDS!!
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancien: What a woodsy little cutie fox we have here! And just what might bring you here, precious?
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-1.char: Speak with respect. I've lived more lives than the count of your candles.
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-2.ancien:
[i][font_size=22]Tezcatara bristles with glee.[/font_size][/i]
Oh! How rude of me!
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancie:
Oh! Have you brought your wolf companion?
I've baked him a special [jitter][b]treat[/b][/jitter]!
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-0.ancien:
Look at that! The long-lived fox!
At least my [jitter][b]candles[/b][/jitter] stay lit.
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-1.char: If we did not share a love of candles, I'd burn you.
TEZCATARA.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-2.ancien:
[i][font_size=22]Tezcatara cackles with delight.[/font_size][/i]
I'd make the [sine]Prettiest[/sine] candle!
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-0.ancient: Aaaah, was our [sine]encounter[/sine] not enough for you, Witch?
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-1.char:
Unfortunately.
I require more power, demon.
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.0-2.ancient: You and I are going to have some [i]fun[/i].
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-0r.ancient: Maybe I could save the woods if you would offer more...
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-0.char: These deals are not worth my time...
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-1.ancient:
And yet you keep coming back.
What a pathetic excuse.
VAKUU.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.2-2.ancient:
Once you've found my equal, leave.
Until then, I eagerly await your return, Witch.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEWITCH-WITCH.1-1r.c: They come to reclaim what's ours!
